evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 慈云普护
evidence.excerpt_zh: 碧桐書院之西為慈雲普䕶前殿南臨後湖三楹為歡喜佛塲其北樓宇三楹有慈雲普䕶額上奉觀音大士下祀關聖帝君東偏為龍王殿祀圓明園昭福龍王（圓明園冊）臣等謹按慈雲普䕶四十景之一也與歡喜佛塲額皆世宗御書龍王殿額曰如祈應禱關帝殿額曰昭明宇宙皆世宗御書又龍王殿額曰功宣普潤聨曰正中徳備乾符應利濟恩敷解澤流皇上御書
evidence.summary: West of 碧桐書院 on the Back Lake 後湖: a three-bay front hall (歡喜佛塲), a three-bay tower with Guanyin above and Guandi below, and an eastern 龍王殿 for the garden's 昭福 dragon king.

evidence.title: 释圆明园慈云普护之多神殿
evidence.summary: 慈云普护 Ciyun Puhu, north shore of 后湖, 120 x 90 m, 800 m2 of buildings. A temple garden for several faiths: 欢喜佛场 for Buddha, a tower with 观音 above and 关帝 below, and the 龙王殿 for 昭福龙王. Cites a 1794 repair list giving three bays with a three-bay rear annex for 欢喜佛场.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 欢喜佛场, 3x1 cells.
